_comment: DEMO TESTIMONIALS. Replace with real customer reviews before public launch. These are fictional, illustrative content - they are NOT verified reviews and the site never presents them as such.

items.name: Martin K.
items.sk: Skvelá atmosféra, čistý fade a veľmi profesionálny prístup. Určite sa vrátim.
items.en: Great atmosphere, clean fade and a very professional approach. Definitely coming back.

items.name: Jakub M.
items.sk: Presne ten štýl, aký som chcel. Dobrá komunikácia a dôraz na detail.
items.en: Exactly the style I wanted. Good communication and attention to detail.

items.name: Tomáš R.
items.sk: Prvýkrát som odišiel so strihom, na ktorom sme sa naozaj dohodli. Brada perfektne upravená.
items.en: First time I left with the haircut we actually agreed on. Beard perfectly shaped.

items.name: Michal P.
items.sk: Rýchlo, čisto, presne. Nemám čo vytknúť.
items.en: Quick, clean, precise. Nothing to fault.

items.name: Adam V.
items.sk: Konečne niekto, kto rozumie dlhým vlasom. Chce to trochu času, ale výsledok stojí za to.
items.en: Someone who finally understands long hair. It takes a bit of time, but the result is worth it.

items.name: Samuel K.
items.sk: Prišiel som s fotkou a odišiel s presne tým istým. Perfektná práca s kontúrami.
items.en: I came in with a photo and left with exactly that. Excellent work on the contours.

items.name: Filip B.
items.sk: Príjemné prostredie a naozaj poctivá práca. Holenie hladké, žiadne podráždenie.
items.en: Pleasant environment and really careful work. A smooth shave, no irritation.

items.name: Dominik H.
items.sk: Dobrý strih za rozumnú cenu. Občas treba počkať, ale to sa dá pochopiť.
items.en: A good haircut for a fair price. Sometimes you have to wait, but that's understandable.

items.name: Peter L.
items.sk: Chodím pravidelne už nejaký čas a kvalita je vždy rovnaká. To si na tom cením najviac.
items.en: I've been coming regularly for a while now and the quality is always the same. That's what I value most.

items.name: Lukáš T.
items.sk: Detaily, kontúry, fúzy – všetko sedí. Cítil som sa dobre od začiatku do konca.
items.en: Details, contours, moustache – all on point. I felt looked after from start to finish.
